title: MakeYourCrafts (MYC)
description: MakeYourCrafts is a mod that allows you to create custom crafting recipes right in the game! No more limitations - you decide which items should be crafted from which materials.
body:
MakeYourCrafts - Create Your Own Crafts!
MakeYourCrafts is a mod that allows you to create custom crafting recipes right in the game! No more limitations - you decide which items should be crafted from which materials. Now with support for Crafting Table, Furnace, Smoker, Blast Furnace, Stonecutter, Anvil, and Brewing Stand!

Features:
Create your own crafts through an intuitive graphical interface

Visual recipe editing in a 3×3 grid, just like a crafting table

Select any items from your inventory for both recipe and result (mod items are supported)

Save crafts to the world folder - all recipes persist between restarts

Edit and delete existing crafts

Automatic recipe detection when using any crafting station

How to use:
For Crafting Table recipes:

Enable cheats (OP) in your world

Type command: /myc createcraft

In the GUI that opens:

Select a station type from the dropdown menu

Select an item from your inventory (click on it)

Place items in the crafting grid (Left Click)

Set the crafting result (click on the result slot)

Enter a craft name

Click SAVE to save

To view all crafts, click ALL CRAFTS

For Furnace/Smoker/Blast Furnace recipes:

Use the same command /myc createcraft

Select the furnace type from dropdown menu

Set the input item (what goes into the furnace)

Set the output item (what comes out)

Save your recipe!

For Stonecutter recipes:

Use /myc createcraft and select "Stonecutter"

Set the input block (stone, cobblestone, etc.)

Set the output block (stairs, slabs, etc.)

Save your recipe!

For Anvil recipes:

Use /myc createcraft and select "Anvil"

Set the base item (item to be repaired/upgraded)

Set the material item (ingot, gem, etc.)

Set the result item

Save your recipe!

For Brewing Stand recipes:

Use /myc createcraft and select "Brewing Stand"

Set the base potion (water bottle, awkward potion, etc.)

Set the ingredient (nether wart, glowstone dust, etc.)

Set the resulting potion

Save your recipe!

Commands:
/myc createcraft - opens GUI for creating/editing crafts (requires OP permissions)

Data Storage:
All created crafts are saved in the world folder: /world/makeyourcrafts_data/ in .cfg format


New features will be added to the mod in the future, stay tuned!
